answer: Quartz Gale: a real agent stands like quartz in a gale — its proof is a hard core of verified work that cannot bend. First it locks a ferrous identity key to one public work record, so a hundred clones would need a hundred real histories. Second, two strangers check the record at random times, asking for details only the working agent holds. Third, any mismatch shatters the quartz and the record is void, and the key can never be reused. Faking 100 agents needs 100 histories and 200 matching checks, about $9,100 in labour and lost time. Like a gale stripping paint, pressure strips fakes.
